title: Create plugin-wide modularization inventory and guard
description: Audit authored plugin files across Admin, CPT, REST, Elementor, Support, assets, scripts, and tests, then define the module split backlog and verification guard for the whole plugin.
objective: Make the 200 to 400 line policy enforceable across the entire plugin, not only Filter Controller work.
expected_outputs: Plugin-wide authored file line-count inventory in RESEARCH-EIT-004
Oversized file risk ranking in RESEARCH-EIT-004
Domain-level split backlog for Admin, CPT, REST, Elementor, Support, assets, and scripts in SUBPLAN-EIT-PLUGIN-WIDE-MODULARIZATION
Reusable line-budget verification script at scripts/verify-line-budget.php
Rules for when a future feature must first execute a split task
acceptance_criteria: The inventory includes PHP, JS, and CSS authored files.
Files above 400, 450, 800, and 1200 lines are classified differently.
Filter Controller modularization is treated as one application of the global policy.
Admin and asset monoliths are not left untracked.
No plugin behavior changes are made by this task.
verification: Agentic Ops validate_research_packet passes for RESEARCH-EIT-004.
Agentic Ops validate_subplan passes for SUBPLAN-EIT-PLUGIN-WIDE-MODULARIZATION.
Line-count inventory command is reproducible through git ls-files and php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict.

budgets.context_budget: entire authored plugin source excluding vendor/generated files
budgets.validation_budget: schema validation, reproducible inventory, diff checks

risks: Inventory without follow-up tasks can become documentation-only debt.
A global split backlog can get too broad unless priorities separate blocking debt from later cleanup.
Feature work can still bypass the policy if the guard is not added to verification.
